title: SpecDriftItem
description: One place where a hexagon's code and its spec disagree, found by spec sync (D144). `kind`: code-vs-contract (code does something the contract zone forbids), planned-now-built (a planned item the code now contains) or fact-mismatch (a hard fact such as a version or pin differs). `file`/`line` locate the code and `contractSection` the spec section; each is `null` when not applicable.
